home_about.title: A tranquil homestay on a hillock
home_about.body: Set on a small hillock amidst a lush green estate spread over 5 acres, Devra is a rustic, quaint and tranquil boutique homestay in Udaipur, merely 10-15 minutes away from the city centre. It allows you quick access to all the major tourist attractions while keeping you away from the city hustle. It has an immersive 360-degree panoramic view of the picturesque Aravalli hills, farmlands, the Sajjan Garh fort and an 800-year-old temple.

home_stay.title: Courtyards and lily ponds
home_stay.body: Encapsulated in 5 acres of lush greenery and heritage city line, Devra, a cozy homestay in Udaipur, has many quaint outdoor sitting arrangements and courtyards with lily ponds at every level for you to hang out with your loved ones, pets or just by yourself.

home_cuisine.title: Relish authentic Rajasthani food
home_cuisine.body: Our dining area caters to a wide range of requests from our guests. The food is prepared in traditional Rajasthani style for all our guests, giving them the true, authentic experience of Rajasthani cuisine.

home_room.title: Spacious, soundproof rooms
home_room.body: The rooms at Devra are spacious and soundproof. They come with either a king-size double bed or twin beds, with traditional yet contemporary architecture, selectively curated furniture, linen and handpicked art pieces.

about_devra.title: A tribal temple where God resides
about_devra.body:
Set on a small hillock amidst a lush green estate spread over 5 acres, Devra is a rustic, quaint and tranquil boutique homestay in Udaipur, merely 10-15 minutes away from the city centre. It allows you quick access to all the major tourist attractions while keeping you away from the city hustle. It has an immersive 360-degree panoramic view of the picturesque Aravalli hills, farmlands, the Sajjan Garh fort and an 800-year-old temple.

In the local language, ‘Devra’ translates to ‘a tribal temple where God resides’. True to its name, Devra believes in the core value of Indian hospitality, “Atithi Devo Bhava”, which literally means guests are gods. This pet-friendly homestay in Udaipur offers 8 rooms with all modern amenities. The refreshing country property has many nooks and corners for you to relax, read a book, paint or simply reflect, making it perfect for couple getaways, family vacations, staycations and artist retreats. Devra is also a great budget homestay in Udaipur, offering an affordable and authentic experience amidst natural beauty.

about_hosts.title: Major Durga Das and Jyoti Jasol
about_hosts.body:
Devra, the unique country homestay, is hosted by Major Durga Das (ex-Indian Army), fondly known as Major, and his wife Jyoti Jasol. The couple has been married for 30 years and belongs to the royal ancestral lines of The House of Bassi, Udaipur and the Rathores of Marwar, Jodhpur, respectively. Both Major and Jyoti are animal lovers and like to spend time with their guests and their pets, taking care of them personally during their stay. They will happily accompany you, whether going for morning walks in the farms or spending an evening getting to know Udaipur and Rajasthani culture.

Their hospitality is deeply rooted in their large joint family backgrounds, and both have been associated as culture consultants with leading hotel groups in the country, like the Oberoi group and the Udaipur palace, for their events and public relations. Growing up, Jyoti witnessed and learnt the traditional cuisines, and she thrives on sharing them through her food for the guests at Devra. She often conducts heritage cooking classes on appointment, offering a true cultural stay in Udaipur.

stay_leisure.title: Nooks and corners for slow days
stay_leisure.body:
Encapsulated in 5 acres of lush greenery and heritage city line, Devra has many quaint outdoor sitting arrangements and courtyards with lily ponds at every level for you to hang out with your loved ones, pets or just by yourself. The property is surrounded by farmlands and fields, giving a vast open canvas for family get-togethers, events, special occasions, team bonding activities and office get-togethers.

You will find a lot of nooks and corners to read, meditate, practise yoga or paint during your time at Devra. Each floor has common spaces open on three sides that let you feel the outdoors while being inside: the central courtyard, pool, dining area and terrace.

stay_rooms.title: 8 rooms with king or twin beds
stay_rooms.body:
The rooms at Devra are spacious and soundproof, with either a king-size double bed or twin beds. Traditional yet contemporary architecture meets selectively curated furniture, linen and handpicked art pieces.

Large bay windows and living areas open on three sides give you the feel of being outdoors, with fresh air and sunlight, while you are indoors.
items: Electric kettle with tea & coffee supplies

stay_facilities.title: Modern comfort, rustic décor
stay_facilities.body:
Devra offers multiple modern amenities for your comfort amidst nature and heritage-rich rustic décor. It has an infinity pool with a scenic view of the Udaipur city line for you to relax and unwind.

Same-day laundry and taxi services are available, and airport and railway station pickup and drop can be arranged on prior booking. Free Wi-Fi lets you take a staycation and keep up with your remote work schedule.
items: Airport & railway station pickup on prior booking

stay_perfect.title: Couples, families, pets and solo travellers
stay_perfect.body:
Devra is perfect for couples, families with pets, friends and family get-togethers, business leisure, solo travellers, groups of friends, weekend getaways and tourists. Its doors are always open if you are looking for some quiet time away from the hustle of daily life, or if you want to explore Udaipur and retire comfortably at the end of the day.

Devra takes pride in being safe and friendly for solo women travellers from across the globe, and is a great place for a staycation where you can work while cradled in nature. Travelling with your furry companions? Devra is a pet-friendly homestay, so they can come along too.

exp_intro.title: A typical day begins with birdsong
exp_intro.body:
There is a lot you can do around Devra. Bicycling tours to nearby areas and yoga and meditation classes on the terrace are big hits with guests. Major Durga Das, a keen bird watcher himself, will gladly take you birdwatching, while his wife Jyoti Jasol can take you on a culinary tour with her heritage cooking demonstrations.

They would love to give you company on your morning walks as well, and your fur baby will find company with the pets of Devra. A typical day here starts with chirping birds and mellow, warm sunlight knocking at your door. The fresh air will sweep you away as you sip your morning beverage and watch your pets play in the open land.

exp_culinary.title: Farm to plate, supervised by Jyoti
exp_culinary.body:
The food at Devra is a prime attraction: tasty, appetising and made with organic vegetables from our own farms. A farm-to-plate approach means fresh fruits, vegetables and spices, free from toxic chemicals. You will witness and eat authentic Rajasthani cuisine made with love and supervised by Jyoti Jasol herself.

Apart from Rajasthani cuisine, there is a variety of North Indian dishes, and food can be customised to your taste and requirements. Kitchen regulars like pasta, noodles and sandwiches are available on request. Most of the spices are processed by locals at the property itself, and every dish tells the story of Rajasthani food and how it is produced.

exp_community.title: Local hands, solar power
exp_community.body:
Major Durga Das and Jyoti Jasol have not only opened their doors to travellers from across the globe but also created employment and empowerment for local village women, whom you will often see at work during your stay. The property's electricity comes entirely from solar power, a step towards sustainable hospitality and a smaller carbon footprint.

Many local artisans nearby make arts and crafts indigenous to the area. You can support them by buying their work and carrying a souvenir back for yourself or your loved ones.

udaipur_about.title: The City of Lakes
udaipur_about.body:
Known as the ‘Venice of the East’, Udaipur is also called ‘the City of Lakes’ for the many lakes set into its picturesque city line against the Aravalli hills. While the lakes bring serenity, the palaces bring majesty to a city filled with warm culture and spectacular hospitality.

Whether you are planning a solo trip, a trip with friends, a romantic getaway or your wedding, Udaipur has you covered with its colourful ambience, respectful culture and delicious food. With spectacular sunsets and earthiness, there is something for everyone: art and crafts, rich heritage and history, or simply walking the city on a food trail of your own.

udaipur_places.title: Lakes, temples, forts and safaris
udaipur_places.body: From lakes to jungle safaris to temples and forts, Udaipur has everything you might imagine in a lake city set in a desert land. Fateh Sagar Lake and Lake Pichola both offer boat rides. Among the city's temples are Eklingji, Jagdish Temple, Srinathji and Karni Mata. Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary and Kumbhalgarh Fort make a stunning day out, and the markets are full of local handicrafts, textiles and souvenirs.

udaipur_mustdo.title: Sunset on Lake Pichola, and a fort with a 36 km wall
udaipur_mustdo.body:
When in Udaipur, visit the iconic Lake Palace, now a luxury 5-star hotel, and the City Palace on the bank of Lake Pichola for its massive courtyards and elaborate paintings. Don't miss the sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola. Eklingji Temple, 22 km from Udaipur, is one of the most popular spots for its religious and cultural significance.

Trekking fans can head to Kumbhalgarh, 82 km away. Its fort wall stretches 36 km, the longest in India and second in the world only to the Great Wall of China, and there is a wildlife sanctuary too. Finish at Bagore ki Haveli Museum, whose cultural shows bring Rajasthan's history and performing arts to life.

posts.author: Team Devra
posts.title: A photo walk through Devra
posts.excerpt: From the view above the hillock to the four-poster rooms, the lounges and the mud kitchen: a walk through Devra in pictures.
posts.body:
Devra sits on a small hillock in a green estate of five acres, 10–15 minutes from Udaipur city centre. Here is a walk through the house, from the garden to the kitchen.

![Devra and its farmland from the air](media:d-aerial-pano)

## The estate from above

From above you can see how the house sits among the trees, with farmland all around and the Aravalli hills on the horizon. The infinity pool looks out over the city line.

![Infinity pool from above](media:d-pool-top)

## Courtyards and gardens

Every level has a courtyard or a garden corner, with lily ponds and quiet places to sit. On fine mornings, breakfast is laid out in the garden by the stone house.

![Garden breakfast by the stone house](media:d-garden)

## Lounges for slow days

Each floor has common spaces open on three sides: lounges with handpicked art, deep sofas and old wooden furniture, made for reading, painting or simply doing nothing.

![The yellow lounge](media:d-yellow-lounge)

## The rooms

There are eight rooms, spacious and soundproof, with king-size or twin beds. Some have four-poster beds, others have window seats looking onto the green.

![Four-poster room](media:d-four-poster)

## The kitchen

Food is cooked in traditional Rajasthani style with vegetables from our own farms, supervised by Jyoti Jasol, and some snacks still come straight off the chulha, the traditional mud stove.

![Snacks fresh off the chulha](media:d-chulha)

We look forward to hosting you.

posts.title: A slow morning at Devra
posts.author: Team Devra
posts.excerpt: Birdsong, warm light and a walk through the farms: how a typical day begins on the hillock.
posts.body:
A typical day at Devra starts with chirping birds and mellow, warm sunlight knocking at your door. Take your morning tea or coffee outside, where the fresh air comes straight off the fields and the Aravalli hills sit on the horizon.

## Walk the farms with your hosts

Major Durga Das and Jyoti Jasol love to join guests on their morning walks through the farms. If you are travelling with a pet, it will find company with the pets of Devra while you watch them play in the open land.

## Birds, yoga and quiet corners

Major is a keen bird watcher and will gladly take you out for a birdwatching session. Prefer something slower? Yoga and meditation on the terrace are a favourite with guests, and there are plenty of nooks to read, paint or simply sit.

> Devra translates to *a tribal temple where God resides*. The house lives by Atithi Devo Bhava: guests are gods.

When you are ready for the city, Udaipur's centre is only 10 to 15 minutes away.

posts.title: From our farm to your plate
posts.author: Team Devra
posts.excerpt: Organic vegetables from our own fields, spices processed on the property and recipes Jyoti grew up with.
posts.body:
Food is one of the reasons guests come back to Devra. Most vegetables come from our own farms and are grown free of toxic chemicals, and many of the spices are processed by locals right here on the property.

![The dining hall at Devra](media:w-59)

## Authentic Rajasthani cuisine

Every meal is cooked in traditional Rajasthani style and supervised by Jyoti Jasol herself. She learnt these recipes growing up in a large joint family and loves sharing the stories behind each dish.

## Something for everyone

Alongside Rajasthani food, the kitchen makes a variety of North Indian dishes and can adjust any meal to your taste. Pasta, noodles and sandwiches are available on request.

## Cook with Jyoti

Jyoti conducts heritage cooking classes on appointment. Ask us when you book and we will plan a session during your stay.

posts.title: Day trips from Devra: lakes, palaces and forts
posts.author: Team Devra
posts.excerpt: Udaipur's lakes and palaces are minutes away. Here is how we suggest planning your days.
posts.body:
Devra is 10 to 15 minutes from the city centre, so you can spend the day exploring and come back to the quiet of the hills by evening.

## In the city

- **Lake Pichola**: take the sunset boat ride.
- **City Palace**: massive courtyards and elaborate paintings on the bank of Lake Pichola.
- **Fateh Sagar Lake**: a calm lake with boat rides.
- **Bagore ki Haveli**: cultural shows with local performing artists.

## Further out

- **Eklingji Temple**, 22 km from Udaipur, known for its religious and cultural significance.
- **Kumbhalgarh**, 82 km away. The fort's 36 km wall is the longest in India and the second longest in the world after the Great Wall of China. There is a wildlife sanctuary too, and it is popular with trekkers.

## Getting around

We arrange taxis, and airport and railway station pickups on prior booking. Udaipur Airport is 32 km away and the railway station is 12 km.
